index.accordionTitle: Tips for optimal use of OTTIS
index.tip1: For effective capture, avoid noisy environments and prefer a quality microphone (ideally: headset or lavalier mic).
index.tip2: For better subtitle readability, keep sentences short and pause at the end of each sentence.
